facts.fact: 她划船离开岛；座下多了一支 Clay 偷偷用她几天前问过的那块木头削成的第二支桨（一端削平、一端收窄以卡进桨架）
facts.anchor: A second oar—made from the piece of wood I had asked Clay about days ago.

facts.fact: 她划了一两小时，发现自己在想 Nana、想 James——却对 James 毫无感觉，只想着 Clay
facts.anchor: I try to think of James. I try to feel some longing for his hands against my skin

facts.fact: 祖母的话：「There is nothing more powerful than a woman who knows her worth—and won’t ever be convinced otherwise.」
facts.anchor: There is nothing more powerful than a woman who knows her worth

facts.fact: 她掉头划回岛；风暴来了，岛消失，她哀求「Take me back」，浪把她送回去
facts.anchor: “Take me back,” I whisper, I plead

facts.fact: 她进门说「I couldn’t leave」；Clay 说苏格兰语 drookit（浑身湿透）；她说不想回西雅图、不想回 James，要留在这里
facts.anchor: “I don’t want to go back to Seattle, back to James. I want to stay here. With you.”

facts.fact: 事后她等愧疚来，它没有来；她看着 James 的钻戒觉得「像一场骗局、戴错了人」
facts.anchor: It feels like a hoax, like it was put on the wrong woman

facts.fact: 几天后她把 James 的戒指摘下来，藏进床头抽屉最里面
facts.anchor: I open the bedside drawer and tuck it in the far back, among the dust.

facts.fact: Clay 醒来说「I want you here with me, on this island, in this house. I want you.」
facts.anchor: I want you here with me, on this island, in this house. I want you.

facts.fact: 四个月过去，又过了五个月；两人一起种地、捞海藻烧盐
她问起他的妻子（她心里叫 Alice，不敢说出口）；他说这块地是 Alice 家的，十英亩、传了三代
他说当年娶她是「该做的事」：她父亲去世、母亲撑不住；两人互相尊重，但不是书里那种爱
facts.anchor: Marry her. Take care of the house, work the land as well as my own up the ridge.

facts.fact: 他说失去她「是惩罚」——罚他没有像应该的那样爱她
facts.anchor: Not loving her like I should’ve. Not looking at her like she deserved.

facts.fact: Clay 指出她还在看海平线、还在照看那条船：「Yer only half here」
facts.anchor: Yer still thinking of leaving, Ellie. Yer only half here

facts.fact: 他逼她二选一：「Ye don’t get to have both」——旧生活与这段生活
facts.anchor: Ye don’t get to have both

facts.fact: 他留下一句盖尔语「Whit’s fer ye’ll no go by ye」（命里属于你的不会错过），独自走开
facts.anchor: Whit’s fer ye’ll no go by ye

facts.fact: 冷战三天后他在门廊道歉；她说「I love you」；两人在门廊抱在一起
facts.anchor: “I love you,” I dare to say

facts.fact: 夜里她拉他下海游泳；他说她像 selkie（海豹精）
结尾：暗处出现一道微光、海平线上有灯——「We are not alone」
facts.anchor: But a shiver of light appears in the dark.
